tagline.zh: 奥术、火焰或冰霜远程爆发，控制与机动出色。
tagline.en: Arcane, Fire or Frost burst with strong control and mobility.

strengths.zh: 爆发高、控制多、自带吃喝与传送。
strengths.en: High burst, rich control, conjured food and teleports.

drawbacks.zh: 身板脆，法力管理要求高。
